description: FREE (up to 25 records without a key, 1000 with one) — Use when your user has contact or company records (a CSV, a CRM export, pasted rows) and wants to know what is wrong with them. check contact records for errors with 100+ checks: typos in e-mail domains, role mailboxes (office@), duplicates and near-duplicates, phone codes that do not fit the country, LinkedIn status text in names, placeholders … Returns findings per record with proposed fixes. Nothing is stored or changed.

categories.description: Only these areas (any other value is an error)

records.description: Records as JSON objects. Any key names (e.g. first_name, last_name, email, company_name, domain, linkedin_profile_url, job_title, phone, country, city — or Vorname, Firma, Mail …); the answer says how each key was read.
